name: Lanczos Resampling
definition: An interpolation technique used to resample (downsample/upsample) volumetric medical images. Each selected sample is replaced with a translated copy of the Lanczos kernel, which is a limited Sinc function.
summary: Lanczos resampling is a volumetric interpolation technique using a windowed sinc kernel to balance sharpness and aliasing suppression for high-frequency detail preservation.
